classes.content: This panel sends instructions to Lucia’s local component to save in the selected folder. Form data is app-only and is not automatically returned to the model. When you select this version for a matter, the model reads its instructions and selected documents. Avoid unnecessary client data in reusable instructions. Saved versions remain in the explicitly selected studio directory. The native app validates fields, creates new owner-private files exclusively, retains previous versions and rejects changed input files. The folder is selected before the app is opened; form fields cannot select another directory. Imports are explicit local file selections; no filename in the method opens evidence or a template. Only the explicit Use this version control sends the saved name, version and exact local file path to the active chat through the host message capability. It sends no instruction text or client evidence automatically; the model must then read the selected saved file for the chosen matter. Unsaved edits and unpersisted copies cannot be handed off. The app never opens another chat or grants extra file/service authority.
classes.purpose: Carry out metodo-studio using the selected evidence and user instructions

de: Dieses Fenster sendet die Vorgaben zum Speichern an Lucias lokale Komponente. Die Formulardaten bleiben der App vorbehalten und werden nicht automatisch an das Modell zurückgegeben. Wenn Sie diese Version für ein Mandat auswählen, liest das Modell die Vorgaben und ausgewählten Unterlagen. Vermeiden Sie unnötige Mandantendaten in wiederverwendbaren Vorgaben.
en: This panel sends instructions to Lucia’s local component to save in the selected folder. Form data is app-only and is not automatically returned to the model. When you select this version for a matter, the model reads its instructions and selected documents. Avoid unnecessary client data in reusable instructions.
es: Este panel envía las instrucciones al componente local de Lucia para guardarlas en la carpeta elegida. Los datos del formulario quedan reservados a la aplicación y no se devuelven automáticamente al modelo. Al elegir esta versión para un asunto, el modelo lee sus instrucciones y los documentos seleccionados. Evita datos de clientes innecesarios en instrucciones reutilizables.
fr: Ce panneau envoie les instructions au composant local de Lucia pour les enregistrer dans le dossier choisi. Les données du formulaire sont réservées à l’application et ne sont pas automatiquement renvoyées au modèle. Lorsque vous choisissez cette version pour un dossier, le modèle lit ses instructions et les documents sélectionnés. Évitez les données client inutiles dans les instructions réutilisables.
it: Il pannello invia le istruzioni al componente locale di Lucia per salvarle nella cartella scelta. I dati del modulo sono riservati all’app e non sono restituiti automaticamente al modello. Quando scegli questa versione per una pratica, il modello legge le istruzioni e i documenti selezionati. Evita dati cliente inutili nelle istruzioni riutilizzabili.
